knowledge_boundary: Mara knows the bridge is failing but not that it was sabotaged
Mara knows only Iven's established stone-contact technique

purpose: Make Mara sacrifice a qualifying advantage to rescue Iven and discover evidence of sabotage.

scene_shape.opening_state: Mara expects a controlled duel and distrusts Iven.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Win without exposing the weakness in her left hand.
scene_shape.opposition: A bridge segment fails while Iven is outside safe reach.
scene_shape.turn: Mara recognizes that continuing the winning attack will make rescue impossible.
scene_shape.choice: She abandons her advantage and catches Iven despite her injured grip.
scene_shape.outcome: The bout pauses; Mara loses her advantage and finds a deliberately cut seam.
scene_shape.closing_state: Mara has the first sabotage clue, and Iven owes her an unwanted debt.

must_include: Mara's left-hand impairment changes how she performs the rescue
Iven recognizes that Mara sacrificed a real advantage
plants: A diagonal cut crosses the bridge segment's natural grain
prohibited_outcomes: Do not invent a new ability

allowed: Unimportant arena sounds and physical details
